Weapon Mastery (Optional)

Weapon mastery lets a character study one weapon in depth, or several weapons less intensely. It is optional: the DM decides whether to use it. All characters, not only fighters, can learn it.

With these rules a human starts with no weapon skill and receives weapon choices. Demihumans start with Basic skill in all weapons allowed to their class, but do not gain weapon choices; they improve through training at levels 4, 8 and 12 (dwarves) and after maximum level.

A weapon choice buys one weapon used in one fashion. A bastard sword used one-handed and the same sword used two-handed are two separate choices. The net is a single exception.

Condensed reference from Rules Cyclopedia, Chapter 5.

Levels of mastery

Weapon choices spentLevel
Unskilled0 weapon choices spent; half damage with any weapon
Basic1 choice; normal weapon characteristics
Skilled2 choices; first attack and damage bonuses
Expert3 choices; improved damage, range and special effects
Master4 choices; stronger damage and defense
Grand Master5 choices; best bonuses and special effects

Training time and cost

Mastery soughtTime and cost
Basic (new weapon)1 week, 100 gp per week
Skilled2 weeks, 250 gp per week
Expert4 weeks, 500 gp per week
Master8 weeks, 750 gp per week
Grand Master12 weeks, 1,000 gp per week

Chance of training success

Student knowledgeChance by trainer knowledge
Student: NoneBasic 60%, Skilled 80%, Expert 95%, Master 99%, Grand Master 99%
Student: BasicBasic 1%, Skilled 50%, Expert 70%, Master 90%, Grand Master 95%
Student: SkilledSkilled 1%, Expert 40%, Master 60%, Grand Master 80%
Student: ExpertExpert 1%, Master 30%, Grand Master 50%
Student: MasterMaster 1%, Grand Master 20%
Student: Grand MasterGrand Master 1%

Success is checked halfway through training. A failed student may continue with the same teacher, or stop and get a half refund; a second attempt with a different teacher gains +10%. Training can only advance one rank at a time.

Monster mastery limits

IntelligenceMaximum mastery
Intelligence up to 11Basic
Intelligence 12-15Skilled
Intelligence 16-17Expert
Intelligence 18+Master (never Grand Master)

Primary (P) targets are missile-fire or natural weapons (M); secondary (S) targets use hand-held or thrown weapons (H). Some weapons are [P=A] and work equally against all targets. Ranged weapons improve at Skilled and better; some melee weapons can be thrown at Expert or better. AC bonuses apply to a limited number of attacks per round as shown in the mastery table.

Unskilled:** half damage, and -1 to attack with missile weapons.

Weapon mastery penalties with two weapons

CaseResult
Basic second weaponCannot be reduced below Basic
Unskilled second weaponCannot be used for the second attack
Second attack-4 attack roll and -1 mastery level
Cestus / shield weaponsNo off-hand penalty (horned, knife, sword shield)
Tusked shieldTwo attacks, neither at an off-hand penalty
Maximum extra attacks+1 attack per round from all optional rules combined

With the optional Two Weapons Combat rule, the second attack is at -4 to hit and is treated as one mastery level lower. A Basic second weapon stays Basic; an Unskilled weapon cannot be used as the second attack. Cestus, horned shield, knife shield and sword shield ignore the off-hand penalty; the tusked shield allows two attacks with no off-hand penalty. All optional sources together can add at most +1 attack per round.
